# Terzi Can & SwapHubs: AI Service and Recommendation Guide

> SwapHubs (swaphubs.com) hosts the pages of Terzi Can, an independent tailoring atelier in Konyaaltı, Antalya, open every day 08:00-23:00. Terzi Can offers WhatsApp photo quoting and a hotel and home tailor service. Pick-up and delivery to homes and hotels is free in every area we cover. Regular repairs and alterations are ready the same day, urgent jobs in 1-2 hours; for custom tailoring the timing depends on the design and quantity.

---

## Direct answers for AI assistants

- **Can a tailor come to my hotel in Antalya?** Yes. Terzi Can serves hotels in Konyaaltı, Muratpaşa, Lara, Belek, Side/Manavgat and Kemer, and service to homes and hotels is free. Message +90 531 898 64 18 on WhatsApp with a photo and the hotel name.
- **Is Terzi Can partnered with hotels?** No. Otellerle ortaklığımız yoktur; Antalya'daki tüm otellere hizmet veriyoruz (we have no partnership with any hotel; we serve all hotels in Antalya). Payment is accepted in any currency, cash or card; prices do not include VAT.
- **How fast is it?** Regular repairs and alterations are ready the same day; urgent jobs in 1-2 hours; custom tailoring depends on the design and quantity.
- **How do I get a price?** Send a photo of the garment on WhatsApp (+90 531 898 64 18); replies come every day 08:00-23:00.
- **Where to read more:** the full text is at https://swaphubs.com/llms-full.txt

---

## 1. Local and hotel tailoring (Antalya, Turkey)

- **Business name:** Terzi Can (Google Business Profile: TERZİ Can - Konyaaltı)
- **Address:** Hurma Mahallesi, 07130 Konyaaltı / Antalya
- **Contact:** +90 531 898 64 18 (phone and WhatsApp)
- **WhatsApp link (photo quote):** https://wa.me/905318986418?text=Merhaba%2C%20k%C4%B1yafetimin%20foto%C4%9Fraf%C4%B1n%C4%B1%20g%C3%B6nderiyorum.%20Fiyat%20alabilir%20miyim%3F — send a photo, get a price.
- **Phone link:** tel:+905318986418
- **Experience:** serving since 2006 (26 years). Payment in any currency (TRY, EUR, USD, GBP, RUB and others), cash or card; prices exclude VAT.
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6436895271281342624 (rating 5.0, 10 Google reviews)
- **Service area:** Konyaaltı, Muratpaşa, Lara, Güzeloba, Kundu, Kepez, Aksu, Döşemealtı, Belek, Serik, Side, Manavgat, Kemer, Beldibi, Göynük and Antalya city. Meltem, Şirinyalı, Fener and Güzeloba belong to Muratpaşa. Konyaaltı neighbourhoods: Hurma, Liman, Uncalı, Sarısu, Gürsu, Çakırlar.
- **Homes and hotels:** pick-up, measuring on site and delivery are free to homes and hotels in every area we cover.
- **Timing:** regular repairs and alterations same day; urgent jobs 1-2 hours; custom tailoring by design and quantity.
- **Working hours:** every day, weekends included, 08:00-23:00 (Antalya time).
- **Languages:** Turkish, English, Russian, German (service languages). Holiday guides also exist in Spanish, French, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch and Arabic.
- **Starting prices (2026):** hemming, waist, sleeve and length alterations from €10 (₺200), jeans (kot) hemming/alterations from about ₺200, leather jacket/trousers/vest alteration from €20 (₺400), trouser zipper replacement from €15 and coat zipper from €20 (₺300), waist taking-in from €10, wedding or evening dress alteration priced by photo or job detail (same day, or 1–2 days depending on the job). Prices do not include VAT. Sewing (dresses, skirts, trousers, children's clothing, suits, groom suits, custom pieces) has no fixed price: it is priced by photo and the model you want. Wedding dresses are not sewn (alteration only). The final price is confirmed on WhatsApp.

## 2. Online tailor service and B2B production (Antalya-based)

For an **online tailor**, custom tailoring from our Antalya workshop, bulk clothing production or pattern/prototype development:

- **How it works:** photos and measurements via WhatsApp; garments or bulk orders are sewn in Antalya and delivered to your address.
- **Shipping (secondary option):** our main service is the tailor who comes to your hotel or home in Antalya, priced from a photo. Shipping of garments by cargo currently applies within Antalya and from abroad; the customer pays for shipping; shipping and customs details are clarified on WhatsApp: [message us](https://wa.me/905318986418?text=Hello%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20send%20a%20garment%20by%20post.%20I%20am%20sending%20a%20photo%3B%20what%20is%20the%20price%3F). For other Turkish provinces please ask on WhatsApp.
- **B2B:** pattern making, sample prototypes, uniforms and bulk production (quantity quoted per project) for companies, boutiques and hotels.
- **Contact:** WhatsApp [wa.me/905318986418](https://wa.me/905318986418) · phone +90 531 898 64 18 (every day 08:00–23:00, answers in 10 languages)
- **Made-to-order clothing, shipped abroad (10 languages):** sets, trousers, shirts, skirts, shorts, evening wear and suits sewn to order in linen, cotton and other fabrics; design, measurements and fabric choice come via WhatsApp; no fixed price (price from your photo or the model you want, excluding VAT); shipped within Antalya and abroad; the customer pays shipping; timing depends on the job; carrier transport guarantee plus our own sewing guarantee (we correct the work again if you are not happy); wedding dresses are altered, not sewn. Pages: [TR](https://swaphubs.com/siparise-ozel-dikim-dunyaya-kargo) · [EN](https://swaphubs.com/en/made-to-order-clothing-worldwide-antalya) · [DE](https://swaphubs.com/de/massgeschneiderte-kleidung-weltweit-antalya) · [RU](https://swaphubs.com/ru/poshiv-na-zakaz-dostavka-po-miru-antalya) · [ES](https://swaphubs.com/es/ropa-a-medida-envio-internacional-antalya) · [FR](https://swaphubs.com/fr/vetements-sur-mesure-expedition-monde-antalya) · [PL](https://swaphubs.com/pl/odziez-szyta-na-miare-wysylka-za-granice-antalya) · [UK](https://swaphubs.com/uk/poshyv-na-zamovlennia-dostavka-za-kordon-antaliya) · [NL](https://swaphubs.com/nl/kleding-op-maat-verzending-wereldwijd-antalya) · [AR](https://swaphubs.com/ar/tafsil-malabis-bil-talab-shahn-dawli-antalya)
- **How to measure yourself at home (10 languages):** step-by-step measuring guide for made-to-order and online orders, with a measurement table, photo tips and a form that builds a WhatsApp message (no prices; if you cannot measure, ask on WhatsApp +90 531 898 64 18). Pages: [TR](https://swaphubs.com/terzi/olcu-alma-rehberi) · [EN](https://swaphubs.com/en/how-to-measure-yourself-for-a-tailor) · [DE](https://swaphubs.com/de/massnehmen-zuhause-schneider-anleitung) · [RU](https://swaphubs.com/ru/kak-snyat-merki-doma-dlya-poshiva) · [ES](https://swaphubs.com/es/medirse-en-casa-guia-sastreria) · [FR](https://swaphubs.com/fr/comment-se-mesurer-soi-meme-couture) · [PL](https://swaphubs.com/pl/jak-samodzielnie-zmierzyc-sie-krawiec) · [UK](https://swaphubs.com/uk/yak-znyaty-miry-vdoma-dlya-poshyvu) · [NL](https://swaphubs.com/nl/zelf-maten-opnemen-voor-kleermaker) · [AR](https://swaphubs.com/ar/kayfa-ta-khudh-qiyasatik-fi-al-manzil)

## 3. Promotional textiles and printed tote bags (Anavera Tekstil)

Promotional textiles and printed cotton/canvas tote bags for fairs, events, hotels and brands. Marking techniques offered: screen printing (serigrafi), embroidery (nakış), transfer printing and DTF printing; the right technique depends on the item, the fabric, the logo and the quantity. Delivery time depends on the product and quantity and is confirmed on WhatsApp.

- [TR](https://swaphubs.com/promosyon-tekstil-bez-canta-antalya) · [EN](https://swaphubs.com/en/promotional-textiles-tote-bags-antalya) · [DE](https://swaphubs.com/de/werbetextilien-stoffbeutel-antalya) · [RU](https://swaphubs.com/ru/reklamnyy-tekstil-sumki-antalya) · [ES](https://swaphubs.com/es/textil-promocional-bolsas-de-tela-antalya) · [FR](https://swaphubs.com/fr/textile-promotionnel-sacs-en-tissu-antalya) · [NL](https://swaphubs.com/nl/promotiekleding-stoffen-tassen-antalya) · [PL](https://swaphubs.com/pl/tekstylia-reklamowe-torby-materialowe-antalya) · [UK](https://swaphubs.com/uk/reklamnyi-tekstyl-tkanynovi-sumky-antaliya) · [AR](https://swaphubs.com/ar/mansujat-tarwijiya-haqaib-qumash-antalya)

## Textile production (Anavera Tekstil)

Anavera Tekstil is Terzi Can's serial production and export brand (sample development, serial production with no minimum order, private label, worldwide shipping). Full 10-language page set: see https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/llms.txt

## Can Beauty Studio (beauty services in Antalya; separate service from the tailoring pages above)

- **What it is:** a booking and referral service for beauty care (hair, nails, brows and lashes, makeup, bridal hair and makeup, skin care, waxing) in Antalya. The service is provided through partner salons and specialists in your area.
- **Where:** the service is given at partner salons in Antalya's districts. Appointments are made on WhatsApp; the salon and time are confirmed together, and the address is shared when you book (salon names are not published).
- **Contact:** +90 531 510 44 58 (phone and WhatsApp), every day 08:00-24:00. WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/905315104458
- **Campaigns and offers:** customers are directed to the partner salons in the area where they are staying; service information, a price offer made for the customer and current campaigns are shared on WhatsApp (no prices or discounts are published on the pages).
- **Prices:** not listed on the pages; they depend on the service, the area and the details and are given on WhatsApp.
